clube.titulo: Born in Orlando. Played with Brazilian blood.
clube.texto: United Florida FC is born to be home for every Brazilian who plays soccer in the United States. Based in Orlando, fully registered, with one clear goal: reaching the US Open Cup.

perguntas.texto: What players, families and future franchisees ask most about the club.
perguntas.link: Another question? Talk to the club
perguntas.wa: {{wa:Hi! I found the United Florida FC website and I have a question.}}
perguntas.r1: The United Premier Soccer League is one of the main national soccer leagues in the United States, with clubs in many states. For United Florida FC, it is the way into the Lamar Hunt US Open Cup.
perguntas.q2: Is there an age limit to play?
perguntas.r2: Not in the UPSL adult category. Players aged 20, 30, 35 or older can compete. In the youth teams, tryouts are split by age group.
perguntas.q3: How do the tryouts in Brazil work?
perguntas.r3: You sign up on WhatsApp, get evaluated on the field by the club's coaching staff, and the approved players are called up to Orlando. The dates for each city are posted here and on Instagram @unitedfloridafc.
perguntas.r4: The official UPSL debut is set for the 2027 season, with all of the club's companies fully registered in Orlando by January 2027.
perguntas.q5: How do I buy the official shirt?
perguntas.r5: Pick the model in the store and tap Buy. The order is placed directly with the club on WhatsApp.
perguntas.q6: How does the franchise in Brazil work?
perguntas.r6: The franchisee gets exclusive rights in the city, uses the international brand and the Reebok kit, and is featured on the club's official US website. To learn about the model, talk to the club on WhatsApp.
